title: Overview: Kinetic Energy Harvesting Pavements

title: Glossary & Quick Reference
description: The working vocabulary of Kinetic Energy Harvesting Pavements: CLT, BIM, WAAM, ICF, UHPC, R-value, Cure, Tolerance. The built world is humanity's biggest artifact: better construction and manufacturing make it faster, cheaper, and greener.
definition: Glossary for Kinetic Energy Harvesting Pavements.
key_points: CLT: Cross-laminated timber — structural wood panels.
BIM: Building information modeling — the digital twin of a project.
WAAM: Wire arc additive manufacturing — welding-based 3D printing.
ICF: Insulated concrete forms — foam blocks filled with concrete.
UHPC: Ultra-high performance concrete — exceptionally strong mix.
R-value: Insulation rating — higher resists heat flow better.
Cure: The chemical hardening of concrete and resins.
Tolerance: Allowed deviation — tighter means more precise.
